N° 01 — Robot armApache-2.0
Build it yourself

SO-101

Open-source design: The Robot Studio and Hugging Face

Five-axis arm with a gripper for robot learning and teleoperation. You guide the leader arm by hand, the follower copies the motion – and with LeRobot it learns to do the task on its own.

We sell nothing · you buy the parts directly from suppliers

04 — FAQ
Can I build it with no experience?

Difficulty of this project: Beginner. The project guide takes you through step by step; it is linked under Licence and safety.

Can I buy the robot from you?

No, we sell nothing. You buy the parts directly from suppliers following the project’s bill of materials (the What you’ll need section). We may offer a ready-made kit later; if you want to hear about it, leave your email in the form above.

Are you affiliated with the project’s authors?

No. We work from the open documentation of SO-101 (The Robot Studio and Hugging Face, licence Apache-2.0). The authors are not affiliated with us and have not endorsed this page.

What software will I need?

LeRobot (Python). The software is open source and free; the project guide is linked under Licence and safety.

Is building it suitable for children?

It’s not a toy. The robot contains small parts and electronics; building it is for ages 14 and up, younger children only under adult supervision, for example at school or in a club.

We’re a school or club. What do you offer?

We don’t sell or invoice anything. The lesson with the SO-101 simulation and the worksheet on the For schools page are free; you buy the parts from suppliers following the project’s bill of materials.

Didn’t find an answer?Write to us — a human answers, not a robot.

05 — Project, licence, safetyLicence and safety+

The robot is based on the open project SO-101, created by The Robot Studio and Hugging Face. The design files are published under Apache-2.0, the software under Apache-2.0.
